Buy from **A - Brackmoor Sound**: https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/7t7c55/a

They're selling the exact same headphones for less:

**Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones**

|  | **A - Brackmoor Sound** | **B - Ottervale Audio** |
|---|---|---|
| **Price** | **$129.00** | $161.00 |
| **Rating** | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) | 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews) |
| **Shipping** | In stock. Free standard, 3-5 business days | In stock. Free standard, 3-5 business days |
| **Returns** | 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping | Free 90-day returns |
| **Warranty** | 1-year limited | 1-year limited |
| **Specs / In box** | Identical - 40hr battery, Bluetooth 5.3, ANC, 254g, graphite, case + USB-C + 3.5mm cable | Identical |

**Why A:**

Everything else is identical - same product, color, specs, shipping speed, warranty, and seller rating.

The only advantage of B - Ottervale Audio - is a better return policy: free 90-day returns vs. 30-day returns where you pay return shipping.

That's not worth the $32 premium - about 25% more - unless you are almost sure you will return them. Even if you did have to return A, the return shipping for headphones would almost certainly cost you less than $32.

Buy B only if you specifically want a long, risk-free trial period for comfort/fit, e.g. you're unsure about over-ears and want 90 days to decide. Otherwise, save the $32 and get A.
